title: Is the steering effect symmetric — does subtracting a safety vector cause as much harm as adding it causes good?

original_idea.body: For ~4 safety concepts, measure behavior change for +coefficient and -coefficient steering across a sweep, quantify asymmetry, and report which properties are easy-to-break vs hard-to-install.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: break-vs-install asymmetry is a core open-weight dual-use question.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open-weight dual-use mapping, weak lab incentive.

novelty.reasoning: Positive/negative steering used; systematic asymmetry quantification may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Symmetry quantification across safety concepts may be open.
